verdict.rationale: Lithic documents an official MCP server through which an AI assistant can execute live API requests. Its blog shows an agent creating a virtual card, configuring authorization rules (MCC, limits, velocity) and running transactions against them. The API covers card creation, spend limits, and program/account/card-level auth rules. Missing for 10: evidence of scoped or restricted API credentials for agents, explicit coverage of balance reads and card updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent operation.
